name: StyleRF-VolVis
definition: A framework for editing the style (appearance) of a DVR scene represented by a NeRF model without losing original content (geometry) information, supporting both photorealistic (PSE) and non-photorealistic (NPSE) editing in a single pipeline.
summary: StyleRF-VolVis is a NeRF editing framework that uniquely supports both photorealistic and non-photorealistic style transfer in a single pipeline while preserving original geometry and view-dependent lighting.
